topic: Importing Old Student Data, Dues, and Concessions
summary: This topic outlines the requirements and process for importing existing student data, including their historical dues and any ongoing concessions, into the new ERP system to ensure a seamless transition for fee collection and student management.
steps: Prepare existing student data in a structured Excel format as provided by the ERP team.
Ensure the data includes unique identifiers such as 'Admission Number' and 'University Roll Number'.
Provide comprehensive data for any outstanding dues from previous academic periods for each student.
Include details of any ongoing concessions that old students are entitled to.
Submit the prepared Excel files to the ERP team for import.
business_rules: Each student's registration number (or admission number/university roll number) must be unique in the imported data.
Concessions for old students will be carried forward and applied in the new system if provided in the import data.
important_notes: Timely submission of student data is crucial to enable immediate fee collection in the new ERP.
The ERP team will provide a sample Excel format to guide data preparation.
New admissions will start with a specific series of registration numbers (e.g., from the 26th onwards).
